name: Leaderboard
description: Submit game scores and rank players by their best score, all-time or for recent periods
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read the leaderboard; require auth for submitting scores and for the personal score history (a score always belongs to the signed-in user who submits it, shown under their username); admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Score validation: score is a required whole number from 0 to 1000000000; achieved_at is set by the server when the score is submitted

GET /api/leaderboard ranks players by their best active score in the period: ?period= is all (default), week (the last 7 days) or today (since midnight UTC); each player appears once with that best score (id is the score's id), ties go to the earlier achieved_at, and ranks run 1, 2, 3 without gaps

GET /api/leaderboard returns the top ?limit= players (default 10, at most 100); ?player= returns only that username's row with its rank in the period (empty items when they have no score in it); total counts every ranked player in the period, not just the returned rows
POST /api/scores stores the score and returns it with the player's all-time rank and personal_best (true when it is now their best score)
GET /api/scores returns the signed-in user's own submissions, newest first, with best_score (their highest active score, null without scores)
Deactivated scores (is_active false) are left out of the leaderboard, ranks and best scores; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input or an unknown period, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the leaderboard; signed-in users also get the submit form and their own history, and visitors see a 'Sign in to submit a score' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Leaderboard table: rank, player, score and date, with the top three marked gold, silver and bronze and the signed-in user's own row highlighted
Period tabs for All time, This week and Today, a player search that shows one player's rank, and a 'Refresh' button
Submit form with just the score, which shows the new rank and a 'New personal best!' message when it applies, and the API's validation messages
My scores: the user's recent submissions and best score
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every score, active or not, newest first, with player and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a score's active status from the overview, for example to hide an implausible score

api_endpoints.description: Players ranked by best score in a period

query.limit: Number of top players to return (default 10, at most 100)
query.player: A username: return only that player's row

api_endpoints.description: Submit a score as the signed-in user
The signed-in user's submissions, newest first

data_models.name: Score
data_models.description: One submitted score; ranks and best scores are computed from active scores

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who submitted it)
fields.achieved_at: datetime (set by the server on submission, ISO 8601 in JSON)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false leaves the score out of the leaderboard)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every score with counts
